messages.text: Morning all. Kestrel pitch book goes to the client Monday so I want formatting locked by Friday EOD. Can we agree on one template before more people start touching it?
Morning! Right now I have three versions floating around, the Osprey master and two Kestrel drafts with different footers. Happy to consolidate if someone tells me which is the source of truth.
Use the Osprey master as the base. It has the updated disclaimer page and the new slide master with the 16:9 layout. Kestrel drafts should be rebuilt on top of it.

Formatting nits I keep fixing by hand: inconsistent decimal places on multiples (some 8.0x, some 8x), and footnote numbering resets on every section. Can we standardize on one decimal for all multiples?
+1 on one decimal. Also negative numbers in parentheses everywhere, not minus signs. The comps table on p.14 mixes both.
Got it. I'll run a pass on every table: one decimal for multiples, parentheses for negatives, $ in millions with the unit in the column header only.
Fonts too. Arial 10 for body, 8 for footnotes and sources. I saw Calibri sneak into the valuation summary. Whoever pasted from the model, please paste as values with destination formatting.
Guilty, that was me pasting linked charts from the model. I'll break the links and re-paste as pictures so nothing refreshes unexpectedly when someone opens it.
Better to use the think-cell charts if the template has them. Breaking links on the football field will make it painful to update if the ranges move after the next model turn.
Fair point. I'll keep the football field live in think-cell and only flatten the static charts. Will flag in the file name when it's the final flattened copy.
Naming convention proposal: Kestrel_PitchBook_vYYYYMMDD_initials. Last week we had 'final_FINAL2' in the folder and I nearly sent the wrong one up to Robert.
Ha, that was close. Agreed, adopt it today. Susan, can you move old versions into an Archive subfolder so only the current one is visible?
Will do after the table cleanup. I'll post in here when the archive is done so nobody saves over the wrong file.
Page numbers and the table of contents: TOC is still pointing to old page numbers after we dropped the precedent transactions appendix. Needs a manual refresh before anything goes to print.
I can take the TOC and cross-references. Will also check that section dividers use the same accent color, the Osprey one is slightly teal versus navy in the other drafts.
Last thing: sources line under every chart and table, same wording, same position. Compliance flagged missing source notes on a prior book and I don't want a repeat.
I'll draft the standard source language and drop it in the template notes. Then everyone just copies it instead of retyping.
Archive is done and the table pass is finished through p.22. Remaining pages have a few custom layouts, I'll finish those after lunch.
Nice work, Susan. Ping me when the full pass is done and I'll do a final read-through for alignment and widows before it goes to Robert for sign-off Friday.
